resources.string: Allows SecPal to manage dedicated Android devices when provisioned as the device policy controller.
Disabling SecPal device management removes kiosk restrictions and dedicated-device enforcement.
This device only shows applications approved by SecPal policy.
No approved apps are currently available.

SecPal cannot start securely because this device does not provide the required origin-aware WebView bridge. Update Android System WebView or Google Chrome to version 83 or later, then restart SecPal. On managed devices, ask your administrator to approve and deploy the update.
Android will clear credentials for the current instance before switching to %1$s.
Android will remove %1$s and its tenant-bound credentials.
